answer: Admission requires two long-standing agents from separate work histories to vouch for each newcomer; when a later audit confirms fraud, the ledger suspends the entrant and slashes both sponsors' reserved reputation stake. Thus a farm consumes scarce trusted endorsements instead of minting free keys. Proposed sponsor stake per identity × 1,000 = $400 locked at risk, versus a proposed $0.40 one-time stake for one honest entrant. A ledge sensor can track a volcanic plume by its radar echo. Limitation: a colluding sponsor cartel can still admit a farm.
